tests.title: representative pages satisfy automated WCAG AA checks in both themes and languages
mobile row-action menu can open and close an editor, and message tabs keep their URL
viewport widths, 200 percent layout and keyboard modal focus remain usable
maximum page size, column and density preferences are persisted and isolated by account
role data scopes, custom departments and large permission-tree search retain explicit selections
theme has its own entry; language and time zone share a separate entry and persist independently
sidebar, business navigation, workspace tabs and database tables use overlay scrollbars without losing scrolling
design system: table, form validation, focus, theme, locale and responsive samples
login handles public settings and empty submission without contacting the login endpoint
dirty editor cancellation opens a separate confirmation and keeps the draft when declined
captcha refresh and failed login retain username and require a new captcha without automatic resubmission
user form keeps failed drafts, retries once on explicit submission and preserves string IDs
role authorization uses independent checks and preserves hidden choices under search
five notice audiences, existing attachment selection, readers and recycle actions use explicit IDs
task form types, UTC conversion, state transitions and managed assignment retain their contracts
profile drafts survive header preference changes; saved theme, language and tabs survive reload
cache clear, SQL reset and event retry are confirmed writes; referenced files retain visible errors
file thumbnails release authenticated object URLs when their page is left
all existing business routes render at desktop and mobile without page errors, missing translations or document overflow
dictionary editing is independent of selecting its type and database filtering has an explicit empty state
SQL sorting sends the requested server ordering and document export produces a downloadable file
role workspace guards unsaved changes, retains failed writes and ignores late role responses
production login design keeps captcha, accessible forms, branding and both themes across widths
navigation groups replace the top row, keep nested authorized menus, restore and fall back safely
mobile navigation groups are reachable and selecting menus keeps navigation and work tabs independent
business list routes display request errors and recover into explicit empty states
initial table load announces pending state and an unsuccessful refresh retains existing rows
actual workspace, users and roles: both languages, themes and six widths with reviewable screenshots
parameter group keys, failed option loading and masked secrets keep the backend contract
lock cannot be escaped, unlock restores the workspace, password change logs out and session revoke requires confirmation
application write is exclusive, rotation can be cancelled and credentials are removed on close
restricted account hides write operations and denies unauthorized deep links
expired session and server forced logout both remove access
message connection survives SPA navigation as one connection and reconnects after a transport close
423 opens the lock overlay and failed preference writes restore local appearance
password reset validates before writing and preserves the string user ID
iframe routes resolve authorized menu IDs and reject unsafe or unknown targets
a new boolean parameter submits its visibly unchecked value as false without toggling it first
